source.origin: Andreas F. Clenow, 'Trading Evolved' open dataset (initial snapshot) + Wikipedia-derived incremental updates by the fja05680 maintainer.
known_limitations: Pre-2001 membership is likely incomplete (487-494 symbols on early rows; canonical target 500).
sp500_changes_since_2019.csv may lag S&P announcements by a few weeks.
Ticker-rename events are recorded as add/remove pairs in the changes file; must be separated from real index churn.
Latest event as of download: 2026-08-18. Anything after that is not in this snapshot.

sanity_checks.label: TSLA not in index day before add
FB member day before META rebrand

unresolved_ambiguities.detail: The source dataset preserves bankruptcy-era ticker suffixes (e.g. 'LEHMQ' for post-bankruptcy Lehman, 'AAMRQ' for AMR/AA). Real-world S&P membership for Lehman was under 'LEH' pre-bankruptcy; source conflates these. Downstream code matching PIT tickers against HF must handle these suffixes; HF may store under either variant.

Fiserv rebranded to 'FI' on 2024-07-11 but fja05680 changes file does not record this event. PIT membership therefore does not reflect the rename; downstream code must alias FI ↔ FISV manually (already done in phase1.hfdatalibrary_adapter TICKER_ALIASES).

Historical snapshot begins with 499 tickers on 1996-01-02 and slowly grows to 494 by 2001-01-16. Maintainer suspects missing symbols in early years but could not verify. Do not use PIT membership prior to 2001-01-16 for confirmatory work.

Latest change in the fja05680 changes file is 2026-08-18. Any S&P membership event between 2026-08-19 and dataset use date is not reflected. Current Wikipedia snapshot at project start (2026-09-27) shows 503 constituents including RDDT and VMRK (added 2026-08-18) but may include additional post-cutoff changes.

Some historic tickers in snapshots carry `-YYYYMM` suffix marking delisting month (e.g. 'AAL-199702'). Adapter strips the suffix and uses the bare ticker. Provider files in HF might use fully different exchange symbols for old delistings — matching against HF for pre-2010 constituents is imperfect.
